lithos_version: lithos 0.5.0 @ a4d2d62; every error envelope below probed against a live Lithos (MCP serverInfo 3.2.0, 2026-10-04) except where observed_divergences says otherwise

request.notes: Accepted types: `blocks` (to_task is not ready until from_task completes), `parent_child` (from_task is the parent; structural, never blocks), `discovered_from` (non-blocking) and `waits_on_gate` (to_task waits on the gate from_task). Both ids go through the shared resolver — a full id or an unambiguous prefix of at least SIX characters, shorter being `invalid_input` and several matches `ambiguous_id_prefix` with `{id, title}` candidate records; the message names WHICH argument failed (`from_task_id` / `to_task_id`). Validation order, probed: the edge type first, then the self-edge check, then each id's resolution, then existence. On an EXISTING (from, to, type) the call returns the same success payload as an insert, REPLACES that edge's metadata, and leaves `created_by` / `created_at` as they were — so those two fields are evidence of who inserted an edge, which is what T3 D11's removal offer rests on. An edge write emits NO event, which is why Lens re-reads the focal task's edges around the call and publishes its own synthetic `lens.edge_upserted`.

errors.message: edge type 'duplicates' is not accepted in this phase (accepted: ['blocks', 'discovered_from', 'parent_child', 'waits_on_gate']).
An edge cannot connect a task to itself.
from_task_id 'infl' is too short: pass the full task id or a prefix of at least 6 characters.
to_task_id 'infl' is too short: pass the full task id or a prefix of at least 6 characters.
Task id prefix '506155' (from_task_id) is ambiguous: 2 or more matches. Retry with a longer prefix or a full id from candidates.
a waits_on_gate edge requires the from_task (influx-ingest-cutover) to be a 'gate' task, got task_type='task'.

observed_divergences: The success payload is the same for an insert and for a metadata replacement, so NOTHING in it says which happened — the residual T3 D11 states, and the upstream ask (a `created` flag) it would close. Its four keys beside `success` are transcribed from the source (`upsert_task_edge`); the tool's own description only says "with the resolved endpoint ids + titles" without naming them, and the body cannot be probed without writing an edge into the operator's graph. `invalid_edge_type`, `self_edge`, both `invalid_input` too-short cases, `ambiguous_id_prefix` (candidates are `{id, title}` records) and `task_not_found` ARE probed live, as is the validation order and `not_a_gate`. `cycle` and `parent_exists` are not: provoking either needs two real tasks in the right relation, and a rule that failed to fire would leave a real edge behind — so their codes come from the source and their message text is composed. The `cycle` message names members by FULL id and is rendered verbatim; Lens never parses it for logic. `invalid_edge_type` is treated as a Lens defect (the form offers only valid types).
